assign.request: baseline the current Playground zero-to-hero flow

log.msg: setup ok: 8917 answers 200; untitled.json on disk already has a pre-built holy-grail branch (not a pristine seed) - baselined against it as-is

selection: default load auto-selects doc root; canvas click and tree-row click both select correctly and stay in sync; nothing-selected is UNREACHABLE via the UI (no deselect gesture exists) - only reached by forcing pg.selected=null via eval

sidebar inventory: label,width,height,padding,grow,shrink,basis,self,order,colSpan,rowSpan,area (12) always show for Box; Flex adds direction/wrap/justify/align/gap (17 total); Grid adds columns/rows/areas/flow/gap; a pg-readout CSS string always shown; nothing-selected shows only 'Nothing selected.'

HEADLINE 9-cell table (+FLEX/+GRID/+BOX x nothing/top-level-box/nested-box), driven live and dumped via doc.toJSON(): fully CONSISTENT across all 3 buttons in every state - placement depends only on selection, never on item type. nothing-selected -> lands as CHILD of doc root. top-level-box selected -> lands as SIBLING beside it inside root. nested-box selected -> lands as SIBLING beside it inside its own immediate parent (stays at that depth, never jumps to root). No inconsistency found.

zero-to-hero: New Document (dropdown) HANGS FOREVER and never switches docs - reindex()/root.save() await Socket.ready which never resolves since the throwaway server fails the WS handshake (200 not 101). Confirmed live: 2.5s+3s after clicking, doc dropdown still reads untitled, tree root still page. Meanwhile old-doc interaction stays fully alive (save() is fire-and-forget from repaint(), never awaited) - added a Box to the old doc right after triggering the hang, worked fine, no console error.

zero-to-hero count (built on the existing untitled doc since New Document is broken): 9 structural gestures for the correct header/left-main-right/footer nesting (+FLEX shell, click COLUMN, +BOX header, +FLEX content-row auto-sibling, +BOX left, +BOX main auto-sibling, +BOX right auto-sibling, reselect header, +BOX footer). Labeling adds ~5 more field edits but the label input does NOT select existing text on focus - naive typing appends INTO the default label (got headerBox/leftBox/mainBox/rightBox/footerBox instead of header/left/...), so a clean label needs an extra select-all first. Also: with no explicit height, new boxes collapse to ~1.5em min-height - the shape is right but visually tiny next to the existing hand-sized holy-grail example unless you also set heights/grow.

resize: two ext/grip rails (tree, properties) work correctly - dragged properties grip +150px, rect grew exactly dw:+150, width persisted to localStorage lew42-pg-rails immediately (client-side, unaffected by the dead dev server). Canvas boxes have ZERO resize affordance - dragged a box's right edge with a full pointerdown/move/up gesture, rect was byte-for-byte unchanged (dw:0,dh:0). No column/box resize exists today, only the two rail grips.

persistence: writes never throw (FileSaver.write awaits a never-resolving Socket.ready instead of erroring; console shows only the expected repeated WS-handshake-failed error, no pageerror). Saves are fire-and-forget from repaint() so a stuck write never blocks interaction. But since the queue (Saver.drain) never advances past that first stuck write, every doc edit made against this throwaway server is effectively unsaved for the whole session, silently.

skill-improvement note filed separately: ui-test's parse() splits click/hover selectors on bare whitespace, so an unquoted multi-token CSS selector (combinators with spaces, or [title="Add Flex"]) silently clicks only the FIRST token instead of erroring - caused a wrong-element click (selected a deeply nested node instead of the intended top-level one) before I switched to no-space compound selectors or quoted text= selectors.

assign.outcome: baseline complete: 9-cell table is fully consistent per button; nothing-selected unreachable via UI; New Document creation hangs forever against a dead dev server while old-doc editing stays fully alive; no box/column resize exists, only the 2 rail grips; zero-to-hero shape takes 9 structural gestures but labels double-type due to a caret-position quirk
